mapper.update: UPDATE research_task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, heartbeat_at = #{now}, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND attempt_count < 3 AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RETRYING') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now} OR lease_owner = #{leaseOwner})
mapper.select: SELECT lease_epoch FROM research_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} FOR UPDATE
SELECT event_sequence FROM research_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}
mapper.update: UPDATE research_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', stage = 'CANCELLED', stop_reason = 'USER_CANCELLED', last_error = NULL, heartbeat_at = #{now}, completed_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, event_sequence = event_sequence + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, thread_id, status, stage, attempt_count, request_payload, last_error, heartbeat_at, lease_owner, lease_until, updated_at FROM research_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, owner_id, thread_id, status, stage, attempt_count, request_payload, last_error, heartbeat_at, lease_owner, lease_until, updated_at FROM research_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND client_request_id = #{clientRequestId}

SELECT id, owner_id, thread_id, status, stage, attempt_count, request_payload, last_error, heartbeat_at, lease_owner, lease_until, updated_at FROM research_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND runtime_type = 'RESEARCH_AGENT' AND COALESCE(heartbeat_at, updated_at) < #{heartbeatBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
